svg.aria-label: Component diagram of TransferOrbit: 24 ES modules. Imports only ever point downwards; the single way back up are the two signals changed and tick, carried by the events module. The presentation consists of two halves, canvas and panels, which do not import each other.
svg.title: TransferOrbit - components and their dependencies
svg.text: 24 ES modules under js/ (version 44). Number in the circle: layer. Number on the right: lines.
The order drawn is one valid order, not a forced one - much of what sits side by side is independent.
imports - every module may import from any layer below it, never the other way round
two halves - neither imports the other. Only ui/display and ui/menu know both.
connects both sides, loads the save
on top the two that are the only ones to know both halves; below, the plain HTML
three layers, one picture - knows nothing of the panels
the only thing that changes the game state
where things are, which way costs what - changes nothing
reference data and pure queries on it
knows neither the game nor the map nor the interface
